name: bug
description: Unexpected plugin behavior or a confirmed defect.

name: enhancement
description: A new capability or improvement to existing behavior.

name: question
description: Configuration help or behavior that needs explanation.

name: documentation
description: README, wiki, or in-plugin help corrections.

name: translation
description: Incorrect, unclear, or untranslated wording in a supported language.

name: regression
description: Behavior that worked in an earlier version and subsequently broke.

name: needs-triage
description: New report awaiting maintainer review and classification.

name: needs-info
description: Additional information is needed from the reporter.

name: confirmed
description: The reported defect has been reproduced or verified from evidence.

name: needs-testing
description: A proposed fix needs reporter or live Unraid verification.

name: area:scheduling
description: Daily, weekly, custom schedules, increment windows, or cron.

name: area:temperature
description: Temperature thresholds, thermal pauses, or critical-temperature protection.

name: area:background-tasks
description: Mover, backup/restore detection, and background pause ownership.

name: area:restart
description: Operation restart after array stop/start, shutdown, or reboot.

name: area:notifications
description: Notification content, delivery, severity, duplicates, or completion ownership.

name: area:history
description: Progress accounting, parity history persistence, or history presentation.

name: area:assistant
description: Partial-check bounds, correction mode, monitoring, or the sector popup.

name: area:installation
description: Installation, update, removal, packages, or native hook ownership.

name: area:ui
description: Settings, forms, layout, dialogs, browser interactions, or accessibility.

name: priority:critical
description: Maintainer-assigned: immediate investigation of severe data or operational impact.

name: priority:high
description: Maintainer-assigned: significant confirmed impact that needs prompt attention.

name: duplicate
description: Already tracked by another issue; link the original report.

name: wontfix
description: The requested change is not planned; record the reason when closing.

name: accessibility
description: A barrier affecting people with disabilities.

name: help wanted
description: Contributions or additional investigation are welcome.

name: good first issue
description: A scoped, documented task suitable for a first contribution.

name: invalid
description: Not an actionable plugin issue; use needs-info for incomplete reports.
